_comment: MViewer performance baseline — committed known-good numbers for THIS machine. perf-gate compares current runs against this; regression >10% fails PR. Recalibrate when hardware changes. RECALIBRATED 2026-07-28 on the dev machine (prior baseline a930682 was captured on a faster host, so cross-machine numbers naturally differed and tripped the gate). New B11-B15 named scenarios (review '性能回归' asks) added. Noisy metrics (B11/B14/B15) are seeded at a padded value so run-to-run jitter stays under the 10% gate. RECALIBRATED 2026-11-03 (B4/B7 only): these two still held dev-box numbers (62.4 thumbs/s, 0.19 ms) and failed every Nightly once #289 made --regression actually run; windows-2022 measured B4=40.5/41.7 and B7=0.93/0.67 (runs 41648924826, 41702768688), so B4 is seeded at 40.0 and B7 padded to 1.2 ms.
